description: Create an infrastructure network - a named grouping of features bound to one feature class. Requires infrastructure_networks:write scope.

criticality.description: How strictly the network is held to its feature class's Level of Service targets: critical, high, medium or low. Unset is treated as medium; send null on update to clear it

feature_class.description: Asset class code (must exist; resolve via list_infrastructure_feature_classes)

name: create_infrastructure_network
title: Create infrastructure network
